title: PingIt
description: A simple mod that allows you to ping locations with nice looking icons.
body:
![pingit title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75b996776bc33149b9960f1c96df28e1b0fbe651.png) ![divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97667c6a407865da24915c7252be40556c32ad52.png) **PingIt** is a lightweight and highly customizable mod designed for both **singleplayer and multiplayer**. Quickly communicate danger, or points of interest with clean, unobtrusive icons. Pings can be customized separately for yourself and other players - including **colors, icons, and sounds**. Different pings can be selected by opening the ping menu by holding **R**. Alternatively, a quick ping can be used by simply pressing **R**. All pings have a distance limit of **256 blocks**, can be seen **through walls**, and disappear after **5 seconds**. if you find any issues with the mod you can report them on my **[Discord Server](https://discord.gg/3Cx2NHdpef)** ***
Translation **The mod currently supports these languages:** - **_English_** - **_Czech_**
